name: Gourmandise (Draper) Pan-Seared Salmon or Hand-Cut Butternut Squash Pasta (No Walnuts)
brandOrRestaurant: Gourmandise the Euro Bakery & Café (Draper, UT)
whyItWorks: Gourmandise's dinner menu in Draper features tender pan-seared salmon with mashed potatoes and fresh egg-pasta ribbons with sweet, soluble-fiber-rich roasted butternut squash.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pan-Seared Salmon with no lemon sauce, or the Butternut Squash Pasta asking to hold any toasted walnuts/pine nuts and take a lactase tablet for the sage cream.
watchOuts: Ask for no walnuts/pine nuts on the pasta and take lactase for the butter-sage sauce
